metadata.description: 8-bit Claude Code mods for long, parallel, mostly unattended work: worktree pinning, enforced rules, PR watching without polling, enforced modes, claim checks and auto-continue.

plugins.name: anchor
plugins.description: Pin a session to its git worktree: every Bash call runs from the anchor, and the primary checkout is guarded against stray edits and git writes.

plugins.name: tripwire
plugins.description: Rules that are enforced, not remembered: deny, ask, rewrite or note on any tool call, subagents included. An 8-bit trap for every mistake you already wrote down.

plugins.name: sentry
plugins.description: Watch PRs outside the model: polls CI, reviews and threads with gh, wakes the session only when something actionable happens, and denies sleep-poll loops while it watches.

plugins.name: stance
plugins.description: Session modes that are enforced, not requested: investigate, draft, build, ship. Denies the tool calls a stance rules out, auto-switches on phrases like "no code", and shows an 8-bit class badge above the prompt.

plugins.name: anti-cheat
plugins.description: No claims without evidence: flags "tests pass", "CI green" and "verified" claims that nothing in the turn backs up.

plugins.name: respawn
plugins.description: Auto-continue after a turn dies on a network or API error: an 8-bit CONTINUE? countdown with backoff and 3 lives per hour.
